VMess + WebSocket NTLS on 80 — PRIMARY NTLS (TLS->443, NTLS->80)
=========================================================================
vmess:

Manual:
  address <SERVER2_IP> | port 80 | uuid <VMESS_UUID>
  alterId 0 | transport websocket | host redbuntu.duckdns.org | path /vmess | tls OFF
Aliases: 88 (=80); 2082 (NTLS) / 2083 (TLS) vmess-direct.
